class.name: PlayFabMatchTicket

method.name: refresh_async
method.description: Refreshes this tracked ticket snapshot and returns a completion [Signal]. Normal ticket progress is also pushed through [signal state_changed].

method.name: cancel_async
method.description: Requests cancellation and settles from the authoritative native completion. Concurrent calls share one pending signal and one native cancellation request. If a terminal status is already cached but completion has not arrived, the call waits without issuing another native cancel. Successful cancellation returns an OK [PlayFabResult] with null data. If matching wins the race, the result uses [code]E_ABORT[/code], code [code]match_ticket_cancel_lost_race[/code], and this ticket in [member PlayFabResult.data]. Native terminal failures are forwarded unchanged. Calls after completion processing starts or after completion-driven destruction, while Multiplayer remains active, return a deferred [code]invalid_match_ticket[/code] error.

method.name: is_complete
method.description: Returns whether the cached status is matched, cancelled, or failed. This describes the current snapshot; it does not mean the native completion record has already been processed.

method.name: is_cancelled
method.description: Returns whether the ticket is cancelled.

members.member: Raw native ticket status. Compare against [constant STATUS_CREATING] through [constant STATUS_FAILED]; the integer shape is preserved for compatibility.

Local signed-in users supplied by this client when creating or joining the ticket. Remote [member PlayFabMatchmakingTicketConfig.members_to_match_with] entries and the completed match roster are not stored here.
Arranged lobby connection string reported to title code.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when ticket status or completion state changes.
